scope: Gate C internal topology QA of the nine frozen Gate A MINAM N7 polygons. Does not modify Gate B, does not assert Uh_pfas100 equivalence, does not authorize map publication.
authoring_note: Authored after the Gate A capture existed. Every gating tolerance below is either an exact identity or follows from the Pfafstetter definition; none is fitted to observed values.

datasets.role: Frozen ArcGIS JSON in the layer storage CRS (sourceSpatialReference). Primary object of Gate C.
Frozen normalized FeatureCollection in EPSG:4326, i.e. the geometry any future map layer would draw. QA'd so that server projection cannot hide a publication-facing defect.

coordinate_equality.rule: Vertices are equal only if their parsed IEEE-754 values are identical. No snapping, rounding or grid alignment is applied.

geometric_predicates.rule: Orientation and intersection predicates are evaluated in exact rational arithmetic on the parsed coordinates (no epsilon).

union_area_identity.rule: The signed area of the reduced boundary chain must equal the sum of unit signed areas exactly (rational arithmetic).

equal_area_implementation_cross_check.rule: Implementation QA only: ellipsoidal areas from two independent equal-area projections (Lambert cylindrical and Albers conic, both on the WGS84 ellipsoid) must agree within this relative bound.

service_attribute_area_comparison.rule: Reported, never gating. The contract authorizes no area tolerance against AREA_KM2, AREA_FINAL or the 2007 inventory.

external_parent_comparison.rule: Defined only in config/phase2_casma_n6_parent_c6d_preregistration_v0_1.json (tau_m = 50.8 m on the P90 boundary distance; symmetric-difference ratio <= 0.0048238444), committed before the parent was captured.

C0_INPUT_INTEGRITY.rule: Gate A manifest verifies (capture format, statuses, SHA256SUMS) and every Gate C input hash equals the manifest.

C1_RING_STRUCTURE.rule: Exactly one feature per code; every ring closed (first == last), at least 4 positions, no repeated vertex (consecutive or not), non-zero area.

C2_ORIENTATION.rule: All shells share one orientation within a dataset; holes, if any, have the opposite orientation. Native Esri shells must be clockwise. RFC 7946 right-hand rule for the normalized GeoJSON is reported, not gating.

C3_SELF_INTERSECTION.rule: Within a ring, non-adjacent segments must be disjoint (no crossing and no touching); adjacent segments must not fold back collinearly (spike).

C4_SIBLING_OVERLAP.rule: Between different units, segments may only coincide as identical shared edges or touch at a common vertex. Proper crossings, T-junctions (vertex on another unit's edge interior) and partial collinear overlaps fail. Each shared edge must be used by exactly two units in opposite directions.

C5_UNION_GAPS.rule: After cancelling opposite directed shared edges, the remaining boundary must be exactly one simple closed loop with the shell orientation and no pinch vertices. Together with C1-C4 this certifies that the unit indicator functions sum to the indicator of that loop almost everywhere: no positive-area overlap and no internal gap. Any additional loop is reported as an unexplained gap/island with its area.

subchecks.C6a_PFAFSTETTER_COMPLETENESS: Codes are exactly the parent code followed by digits 1-9; NIVEL == 7 and NIVEL7 == CODIGO for every unit.
subchecks.C6b_UNION_SIMPLY_CONNECTED: The union of the nine children is one simply connected polygon (from C5); by the Pfafstetter definition the parent N6 unit is exactly this union within the same coverage.
subchecks.C6c_PFAFSTETTER_ADJACENCY: Interbasins 1-3-5-7-9 form a chain along the main stem, and each tributary basin 2k shares boundary with its flanking interbasins 2k-1 and 2k+1. Required pairs must share boundary length > 0. Additional adjacencies are reported, not failed.
subchecks.C6d_EXTERNAL_PARENT_POLYGON: Comparison against the independently frozen official N6 137596 parent, with metric, tolerance and decision rules preregistered in external_parent_source.preregistration before capture.

C7_AREAS.rule: Union area identity (exact) and equal-area implementation cross-check are gating. Planar UTM, ellipsoidal (equal-area), service AREA_KM2 / AREA_FINAL and 2007 inventory sums are reported with deltas only.

C8_HASH_STABILITY.rule: Every Gate A input hash is identical before and after QA.

decision_rule.PASS: Every gating check and subcheck is PASS.
decision_rule.FAIL: Any gating check or subcheck is FAIL.
decision_rule.NOT_PASS_PENDING: No FAIL, but at least one gating check or subcheck is NOT_EVALUABLE.
